themes.world_cup: World Cup or international tournament match or moment
themes.premier_league: Premier League match, club or moment
themes.champions_league: Champions League match, club or moment
themes.other_league: Another league or competition (LaLiga, Serie A, Ligue 1, EFL...)
themes.club_drama: Club crisis, feud, manager or board drama, fan frustration, not tied to one match
themes.player_story: One player's story, transfer or personal arc, not a single match
themes.other: Anything else or not enough information

formats.match_recap: A real match or its key moments retold as anime
formats.opening_trailer: Anime opening, intro or trailer for a season, competition or club
formats.versus_crossover: Comparison or crossover with a known anime (league vs league, player vs character)
formats.reaction_meme: Short meme or reaction about a result or a club
formats.character_showcase: Showcase of one player or club as an anime character, no match arc
formats.other: Anything else or not enough information
